summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that Tom Allen and Jem Mace arrived in St. Louis from an extended sparring tour of the Northeast and would give a couple of sparring exhibitions during their stay.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Tuesday Morning, October 24, 1876, page 8

facts.fact: Allen and Jem Mace arrived in St. Louis from an extended sparring tour through the Northeast
Allen and Mace planned to give a couple of sparring exhibitions in St. Louis

notes: The short item is entirely about Allen and Mace, so primary rather than secondary.
